cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Make the Choice Rewrite the Past
cards.instruction: Make them choose between options whose consequences reinterpret an earlier promise, refusal, or agreement.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. Keep my spare key or return it. Either choice explains last week's 'take some space.'

mechanism: Copy removal of a key as a relationship signal, then make the partner's choice about a replacement redefine an earlier request for space.
confusable: Not simply discussing a broken key: A must keep turning the practical choice into a verdict on the earlier pause while covering the copied mistake.
comparison: Personal access and a quiet evening, rather than money and business labor.
seedUse: Retains spare-key choice interpreting take-some-space; adds bent-key removal mistaken for relinquishing access.
